PINTAR — read-only identity check, requested by Second Eye before §3b.

Editing this file runs verify-identity.yml. It lists Auth users with the
service-role key (GET only) and reports how many match the digest of the
identity §3b would bind, and the day each was created. It prints no email,
no user id and no metadata. It writes, creates and consumes nothing.
§3b and §3c are not part of this and remain held for Yazid.

attempt: 002
why:     001 got HTTP 401 from the Admin API before comparing anything, so the
         question is unanswered, not negative. The source was correct (the
         `***` in the log is GitHub masking the Bearer value, as it does in
         every workflow here); the cause is in the key or the header form.
         002 reports the key's shape and non-secret claims (role; whether
         ref matches this project), never its value, and tries apikey+Bearer
         and apikey-only, reporting each status and GoTrue's error code.
